title: Verify ResourceSearchRequest field lists against a real bleve index, not just a mock
answers: How do I test that a search request's field list is actually supported?
How to write a regression test for 'unknown response field' errors
Mock-based test passed but production search request failed — how to catch that earlier?
body: A mock-based test that just asserts the request shape (e.g. via fakeK8sClient.On(...)) never validates whether the requested fields are actually supported by the result format — that's how an invalid field list shipped previously. Capture the production-built request with mock.MatchedBy, then run it through a real search.NewBleveBackend/BuildIndex populated with a resource.IndexableDocument, call index.Search with the captured request, and parse via dashboardsearch.ParseResults. Run it for both FIELD_VALUES and RESOURCE_TABLE and assert the consumed hit fields match, so an unsupported field or a format regression fails in the test rather than in production.
applies: Tests covering code that builds resourcepb.ResourceSearchRequest in pkg/services/folder or pkg/services/dashboards where field-list correctness matters.
says: Search field validation test fails only in production
Regression test for unsupported search result fields
Search request field compatibility with real backend
Catch invalid search fields before deployment
Production search fails though mock test passed
search: Tests covering ResourceSearchRequest field lists in pkg/services/folder or pkg/services/dashboards must verify against a real bleve index backend, not just mock assertion on request shape, since mock-based tests never validate whether requested fields are actually supported by the result format. Capture the production request using mock.MatchedBy, run it through search.NewBleveBackend with a real BuildIndex populated from resource.IndexableDocument, call index.Search, and parse results via dashboardsearch.ParseResults for both FIELD_VALUES and RESOURCE_TABLE formats. This pattern (modeled on pkg/services/folder/folderimpl/folder_unifiedstorage_test.go:TestSearchFolders) catches invalid field lists and format regressions in tests rather than production.
